title: Run versioned meeting-feature ablations on identical frozen cohorts
summary: Extend the existing evaluator with a separately versioned, preregistered ablation family while preserving A/B/C/D unchanged. Measure each new feature and selected interactions on the exact same frozen queries/candidates, including difficult/missing-feature cases and negative outcomes.
out_of_scope: Silently redefining B or D to include new features
Selecting thresholds or configurations on held-out labels
Dropping hard queries separately for each condition
Launching every possible combination or the full reported corpus by default
implementation: Freeze a run manifest containing original A/B/C/D packages, common query/candidate/roster/configuration hashes, independent grouped split and factor definitions selected on development data.
Add named conditions such as A+procedure, B+procedure and D+procedure; represent lexical/motif removal as explicit ablations of B rather than claiming those existing features are new.
Select a bounded factorial subset for grammar, prosody, timing/interaction, institution and agenda context, with recorded hypotheses and maximum calls/bytes/cost.
Retain one query inventory across conditions; record feature-unavailable outcomes and both common evaluable cohort metrics and all-query coverage.
Report wrong-name/unknown/anonymous-switch/procedure/attention metrics, paired differences and group-level uncertainty alongside extraction/provider cost; include failures and no-improvement results.

acceptance.criterion: Every condition shares the exact common query/candidate input and baseline A/B/C/D semantics remain unchanged.
acceptance.verification: Validate package hashes and compare common fields; mutate a candidate or query span in one condition and require refusal.

acceptance.criterion: Held-out labels cannot influence factor/threshold selection.
acceptance.verification: Verify development-selection manifest timestamps/digests and run label-sentinel tests at build/inference stages.

acceptance.criterion: Missing-feature queries remain in cohort accounting and cannot silently improve accuracy by exclusion.
acceptance.verification: Use an intentionally missing-prosody subset and compare all-query versus evaluable-cohort denominators.

acceptance.criterion: Reports expose incremental gains, harms, uncertainty and total work on grouped independent units.
acceptance.verification: Inspect paired meeting-level outputs and reproducible report replay with zero fresh provider calls.

tests: Same query but one arm changes candidate order/pool
Procedure family adds later context to only one arm
B baseline with versus without an explicitly named existing motif factor
risks: Many factor combinations create post-hoc selection bias and excessive cost.
The recurring population may yield high apparent accuracy with poor unknown-speaker behavior.

reuse.application: Extend the existing frozen package/report framework using a new schema/arm family rather than modifying A/B/C/D.
Reuse common-config pinning, immutable run directories and label-only reporting.

sources: User clarification, 2026-10-08, active Matter build: DIAT owns meeting learning; roughly 315 hours/5–10 recurring people is user-reported; crawler owns jurisdiction knowledge; private exported-data experiments only.
Original repository inputs: matterbrainstormspec; matterjevmesh; jevinmatter (brainstorming, not implementation evidence).
